doc: properties — what a node of a document is beyond its text (S-16): a heading's level and anchor, a link's address, a code block's language. Each has a type (`bool`, `i64`, `string`, or `enum` with its `values`) and the roles it is stated on (none listed: any role). Append-only.

property.name: anchor
property.doc: The fragment that names the node in its document (`#anchor`).

property.name: href
property.doc: A link's address as written; not resolved.

property.name: title
property.doc: A link's or an image's title.

property.name: source
property.doc: An image's source as written; not resolved.

property.name: language
property.doc: The language of a block of code (`cpp`, `ts`).

property.name: start
property.doc: The number of an ordered list's first item.

property.name: tight
property.doc: The list's items are set close: their paragraphs are not set apart.

property.name: align
property.doc: How a table's cell is aligned.

property.name: raw
property.doc: The text is markup embedded in the document, in this language. A rendering writes it out as markup only where the node's origin is `app` (S-3).

property.name: comment
property.doc: A comment's text: no rendering shows it; a rendering that writes the document's source keeps it.
